note: Four candidate split points between the edge and the cloud. Each is defined by the stage boundary it cuts.

splits.cuts: after capture or decode; before compression
splits.edge_does: capture or decode to raw pixels
splits.payload_formula: width * height * 3 * fps bytes per second per camera
encoded bitrate / 8 bytes per second per camera
keypoints * descriptor_bytes * fps bytes per second per camera
events_per_minute / 60 * bytes_each bytes per second per camera

reminder: At least one of these is arithmetically impossible on the stated uplink. Identify it and say so rather than quietly dropping it.
